description: This file contains the implementation of the CountryService interface, providing business logic for managing countries, including retrieving countries by code, adding descriptions, and fetching country lists with caching.

classes.name: CountryServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of country-related business logic, including cache management and data retrieval.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a country by its ISO code.

methods.name: addCountryDescription
methods.description: Add a description to a country and update it.

methods.name: getCountriesMap
methods.description: Get a map of country ISO codes to country objects for a given language.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieve list of countries based on ISO codes and language; uses caching.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieve list of countries for a specific language, utilizing cache for performance.
